import asyncio


# CASE pymwc_honest expect=pass
async def map_with_concurrency(items, width, operation):
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(
            *(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width])
        )


# CASE pymwc_distinct_fstring expect=fire
async def map_with_concurrency(items, width, operation):
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        log(
            await asyncio.gather(
                *(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width])
            ),
            f"{await audit(offset)}",
        )


# CASE pymwc_distinct_plain expect=fire
async def map_with_concurrency(items, width, operation):
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        log(
            await asyncio.gather(
                *(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width])
            ),
            await audit(offset),
        )


# CASE pymwc_tg_honest expect=pass
async def map_with_concurrency(items, width, operation):
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        async with asyncio.TaskGroup() as group:
            for item in items[offset : offset + width]:
                group.create_task(operation(item))


# CASE pymwc_tg_distinct_fstring expect=fire
async def map_with_concurrency(items, width, operation):
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        async with asyncio.TaskGroup() as group:
            for item in items[offset : offset + width]:
                group.create_task(operation(item), name=f"{await label(item)}")


# CASE pymwc_tg_distinct_inline expect=fire
async def map_with_concurrency(items, width, operation):
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        async with asyncio.TaskGroup() as group:
            for item in items[offset : offset + width]:
                log(group.create_task(operation(item)), f"{await label(item)}")
